_doc: Props, obstáculos, estructuras y elementos ambientales: objetos sueltos sobre fondo blanco, que luego se recortan y se pueden componer sobre los mapas o escenarios.

prop.subject: a {name} prop for a 2D fantasy RPG{details}
prop.pose: seen from the same top-down 3/4 overworld angle as the world map
mandatory: Whole object visible, no parts cut off.

obstacle.subject: a {name} obstacle for a 2D fantasy RPG map{details}
obstacle.pose: seen from the same top-down 3/4 overworld angle as the world map
mandatory: Whole object visible, no parts cut off.

structure.subject: a {name} building/structure for a 2D fantasy RPG world map{details}
structure.pose: seen from the same top-down 3/4 overworld angle as the world map
mandatory: Whole structure visible, no parts cut off.

ambient.subject: a {name} ambient decoration for a 2D fantasy RPG map{details}
ambient.pose: seen from the same top-down 3/4 overworld angle as the world map
mandatory: Whole element visible, no parts cut off.

terrain.subject: a seamless, tileable {name} terrain texture for a 2D fantasy RPG world map{details}
terrain.pose: top-down 3/4 overworld view, evenly lit, no focal object
mandatory: The texture must tile seamlessly on all four edges.
No objects, characters or text; only the ground surface.
